analysis.purpose: Registers every verb as an MCP tool over a standard-input transport — the surface an IDE actually talks to, and the place tool count and description cost are paid every session.
responsibilities: Register each tool with its schema and description
Dispatch a tool call to the matching verb

businessRules.rule: Related verbs are folded behind an op parameter rather than registered separately.
businessRules.rationale: Every tool costs schema and description tokens in every session whether used or not.

businessRules.rule: An under-specified op returns a bad-request error instead of forwarding a partial call.
businessRules.rationale: A dispatcher that forwards incomplete calls returns plausible answers from the wrong verb.

edges.rationale: This file implements mcp server surface.

evidence.quote: const BAD_REQUEST = (message: string) => ({ error: { code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message } });
